blocks.html: Dr. Federico Fiori is a general surgeon and Head of the Abdominal Wall Surgery Unit — ASST Santi Paolo e Carlo, San Carlo Borromeo Hospital, Milan. His work covers general surgery, with a specific field of interest in defects of the abdominal wall: primary hernias, incisional hernias (laparoceles) and rectus diastasis, with particular attention to complex repairs, wall disasters and recurrences after previous surgery.

In January 2019 he published the TESAR technique in the Journal of Laparoendoscopic & Advanced Surgical Techniques, an endoscopic technique for the minimally invasive treatment of incisional and ventral hernias (DOI: 10.1089/lap.2018.0807. PMID: 30807248). The full description of the technique and its results is the canonical source on the hub: the TESAR technique.

The full curriculum — qualifications, congresses, publications and the results gallery — is not duplicated on this site: it is published on the network hub, on the full curriculum of Dr. Federico Fiori page.
